scopeGuide.mcp: MCP client/server, tool gateway, capability servers
scopeGuide.hooks: Git hooks (.githooks, scripts/git-hooks) and agent tool hooks (internal/hooks)
scopeGuide.ai: .mivia/ control surface: rules, skills, doctrines, policy JSON; also internal/skills
scopeGuide.docs: docs/** and docs/OWNERS.yaml (not AGENTS.md - use ai)
scopeGuide.security: secrets, privacy, authz, secret_scan, secure-change paths; also internal/miviaauth, internal/secretpath, internal/envfile, internal/redact
scopeGuide.quality: verify scripts, Semgrep, contract tests, make verify gates
scopeGuide.build: Makefile, go.mod layout, packaging, binary build wiring
scopeGuide.release: versioning, release notes, tag/release process; also internal/version
scopeGuide.events: event bus, subscriptions, adapters, event serialization
scopeGuide.provider: provider clients, streaming, usage and calibration capture; also internal/providerregistry, internal/reasoning
scopeGuide.workflows: internal/workflows/** (controller, delivery, compiler, localengine, stacking, ledger, definition, tasks, template, verifier, matcher, agenttools, presentation), and its infra: internal/ledger, internal/storage, internal/durablefence, internal/remainder, internal/jschema, internal/vcs, internal/workspace
scopeGuide.tools: internal/tools - model-facing tool implementations (write, edit, search_replace, delete, find_symbol_context, etc.), distinct from the agent orchestrator loop and the CLI/TUI

subjectRules: Scope is required and must be one of the allowed scopes
Subject after ': ' starts with a lowercase letter
Imperative mood (add, fix, bootstrap - not added/fixed)
Do not end the subject with a period

trailerHints.Class: add "Class: DC-n" from .agents/quality/defect-taxonomy.md, or "Class: none (<reason>)" when no class fits
trailerHints.Sweep: add "Sweep: searched <what>, found <n> further sites" - the same-class sweep from .agents/quality/defect-taxonomy.md

trailerGuide.Regression: Test that fails before the fix and passes after it.
trailerGuide.Class: Recurring defect class from .agents/quality/defect-taxonomy.md. A fix with no matching class must say so and the class should be added to that document.
trailerGuide.Sweep: Result of the same-class sweep: what you searched for other sites of the class, and how many you found. This is the gate that stops one class producing a chain of repeat fixes.

examples: hardening(agent): fence run admission on the idempotency key
fix(hooks): print allowed scopes on commit-msg failure
docs(docs): document commit scopes in contributing
test(hooks): cover invalid scope error output
ci(ci): run make verify on pull requests
fix(workflows): stop a repairable delivery rejection from parking the run
fix(tools): anchor write_file overwrite diff at the first changed line

Regression.why: A named test that does not exist is not a regression proof. Every Test<Name> in this trailer must resolve to a real func in a _test.go file, the same way validate_invariants.py resolves the names in .mivia/invariants.md.

Class.why: The taxonomy is the repo's catalogue of classes that recur. A free-prose class cannot be swept for, cannot be counted, and does not make the next instance easier to find. Name a DC-n or say none and add the class.

Sweep.why: The sweep is the gate that stops one class producing a chain of repeat fixes, so it must report a COUNT of other sites examined, not an assertion that a check happened. 'Sweep: checked' proves nothing and used to pass.
